corrected_fields.summary: This is a Treasury Department listing page aggregating multiple speeches and statements by Secretary Scott Bessent from January through April 2026. The page contains titles and dates for 11 separate remarks but does not include the full text of any individual speech. This page is non-archivable and should not be stored as a standalone record. Individual speeches should be crawled and archived as separate documents.

Each speech must be accessed individually to extract policy-relevant content. The underlying speeches (e.g., congressional testimony, EXIM Conference remarks) may contain market-relevant information if archived separately.
